title.en: Quality Management Methods in Health Service Management
title.zh: 医疗服务管理中的质量管理方法

sourceNotice.en: Lecture 2, 15 September 2026. Based on the 51-page slide deck and classroom transcript. Summaries and practice questions are study aids; the transcript contains recognition errors.
sourceNotice.zh: Lecture 2（2026年9月15日）。根据51页课件与课堂转录整理；总结和练习为学习辅助，转录识别错误已按课件核对。

title.zh: 质量管理的目标与原则

objective.en: Explain the five benefits and five management principles.
objective.zh: 掌握五项重要性及五项管理原则。

sections.title: Five reasons for quality management
sections.titleZh: 质量管理为什么重要：五点必记
sections.html:
老师课堂明确强调 / Lecturer emphasis
Five benefits: patient safety, patient experience, lower costs and waste, better clinical outcomes, and higher efficiency.
五项重要性：改善患者安全、提升患者体验、减少成本与浪费、改善临床结果、提高效率。
Improved Patient Safety: reduce avoidable harm and medical errors.
改善患者安全：减少可避免伤害与医疗差错。
Enhanced Patient Experience: understand feedback and improve the experience of receiving care.
提升患者体验：理解患者反馈，改善接受医疗服务的体验。
Reduced Costs and Waste: use limited resources responsibly.
减少成本与浪费：合理使用有限资源。
Better Clinical Outcomes: improve results of care. Increased Efficiency: improve the use of time and resources.
改善临床结果：提升治疗成效。提高效率：改善时间与资源使用。
This lesson develops PDCA, 5S, BPR and QFD. Other methods in the overview are topics for later teaching.
本讲详细讲 PDCA、5S、BPR、QFD；概览中的其他方法属于后续内容。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师明确提醒这五点是他常问的课堂练习内容；也指出减少成本与提高效率之间可能存在取舍。This was explicitly highlighted for class-exercise revision; cost and efficiency can involve trade-offs.

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 3, 4, 5；Lesson2.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

sections.title: Five management principles
sections.titleZh: 质量管理的五项原则
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Customer focus; continuous improvement; data-driven decision making; employee empowerment; systems thinking.
以服务对象为中心；持续改进；数据驱动决策；员工赋权；系统思维。
Customers include patients, families and providers. Improvement should use evidence and feedback.
服务对象包括患者、家属与服务提供者。改进应利用证据和反馈。
Empower staff to contribute, and consider how departments and processes influence one another.
让员工参与改进，并考虑部门与流程之间的相互影响。
Audits, feedback, corrective/preventive actions, information systems and committed leadership support implementation.
审核、反馈、纠正与预防措施、信息系统和领导支持有助于实施。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师用质量与安全管理岗位说明：政策、风险管理、事故处理、安全文化和跨部门协作需要团队支持。The job example linked the concepts to policies, risks, incidents, safety culture and coordination.

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 15, 16；Lesson2.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

title.zh: 质量评估框架与六项目标

objective.en: Distinguish structure, process and outcome, and explain all six IOM aims.
objective.zh: 区分结构、过程与结果，理解 IOM 六项目标。

sections.title: Structure: resources for care
sections.titleZh: 结构：提供医疗服务的基础
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Structure means the physical, organizational and human resources that support care.
结构（Structure）指支持医疗服务的物质、组织及人力资源。
Examples: hospital facilities, equipment, staff qualifications and training, policies and financial resources.
例子：医院设施、设备、人员资质与培训、政策和财务资源。
A structural indicator can describe the proportion of appropriately accredited staff available for a procedure.
结构指标可描述某项操作中具备适当认证资质的人员比例。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

口诀：Structure＝有什么；Process＝怎么做；Outcome＝结果怎样。This is a study aid, not a lecturer quotation.

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 7, 8

sections.title: Process: actions during care
sections.titleZh: 过程：医疗服务如何执行
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Process is what staff and patients do during care, including communication and clinical procedures.
过程（Process）是医疗服务中的行动，包括沟通和临床操作。
Examples: doctor-patient communication, medication administration protocols and infection control measures.
例子：医患沟通、给药规程、感染控制措施。
Process indicators assess whether evidence-based practices are followed consistently.
过程指标评估循证实践是否得到一致执行。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师强调：设备再好也不能替代良好的医患沟通；解释治疗可帮助患者理解与合作。Good equipment cannot replace communication that supports understanding and cooperation.

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 9；Lesson2.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

sections.title: Outcome: results of care
sections.titleZh: 结果：治疗产生什么影响
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Outcome reflects the results of care: health status, recovery and survival.
结果（Outcome）反映医疗服务产生的影响：健康状况、康复与生存。
Examples: mortality, patient satisfaction, disease complications and hospital readmission rates.
例子：死亡率、患者满意度、疾病并发症、再入院率。
External factors may influence outcomes, so an outcome alone is not always a direct measure of care quality.
结果可能受外部因素影响，因此单个结果指标未必直接等于医疗质量。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师以出院后因伤口问题或病情恶化再次住院说明 readmission；高再入院率应促使团队调查。Readmissions can prompt investigation of care problems.

辨析与学习提示 / Study note

学习辨析：比较医院结果时，应考虑患者病情等差异；不要直接把高死亡率解释为差质量。课件的“易测量”不表示所有结果均容易可靠测量。

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 10；Lesson2.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

sections.title: Connect structure, process and outcome
sections.titleZh: 把结构、过程与结果联系起来
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Improve resources, optimize care processes, and monitor outcomes to identify further improvements.
改善资源基础、优化照护过程、监测结果，再寻找进一步改善机会。
The diagram groups staff, equipment, guidelines and supplies under structure; interactions, investigations, treatment and counselling under process; morbidity, mortality and satisfaction under outcome.
图中：人员、设备、指南和物资属于结构；互动、检查、治疗、辅导属于过程；患病情况、死亡和满意度属于结果。
Having a guideline is a structural resource; following it in practice is a process.
拥有指南属于结构资源；实际遵循指南属于过程。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

本题关键词检查只检查三类是否出现，不能自动判断排列是否正确；请按参考顺序自查。

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 11, 12

sections.title: The six IOM aims
sections.titleZh: IOM 六项目标：全部要记
sections.html:
老师课堂明确强调 / Lecturer emphasis
Safe, Timely, Effective, Efficient, Equitable, Patient-centered.
安全、及时、有效、高效、公平、以患者为中心。
Safe: avoid harm from care. Timely: reduce waiting and harmful delays.
安全：避免照护造成伤害。及时：减少等待和有害延误。
Effective: use scientific knowledge for people who can benefit. Efficient: avoid waste of resources.
有效：根据科学知识提供能让患者受益的服务。高效：避免资源浪费。
Equitable: quality should not vary because of personal or social characteristics. Patient-centered: respect needs, preferences and values.
公平：质量不应因个人或社会特征而不同。以患者为中心：尊重需求、偏好与价值观。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师表示常在课堂练习中问六项目标，并特别补充 Patient-centered：虽然课件没有标红，它同样重要。All six matter, including patient-centered care, which was not highlighted in red.

辨析与学习提示 / Study note

与 Lecture 1 区别：上一讲课件把 Timeliness and Efficiency 合在一个标题下；本讲 IOM 明确分为六项目标。

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 13, 14；Lesson2.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

sections.title: Effective versus efficient
sections.titleZh: 有效性与效率：容易混淆
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Effective asks whether care achieves a useful health result based on evidence. Efficient asks whether resources are used without waste.
Effective 看循证服务是否达到有益健康结果；Efficient 看资源使用是否减少浪费。
Timely concerns waiting and delays; equitable concerns fair quality; patient-centered concerns the individual’s needs and choices.
Timely 关注等待与延误；Equitable 关注质量公平；Patient-centered 关注个人需求与选择。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

新增辨析练习。关键词不能判断两者是否被写反，请对照解释。

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 14, 16

objective.en: Explain each stage and apply the cycle to a healthcare problem.
objective.zh: 解释四阶段，并用于医疗问题。

sections.title: PDCA overview
sections.titleZh: PDCA 全称与循环性质
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
PDCA = Plan–Do–Check–Act. It is an iterative feedback cycle for continuous improvement.
PDCA＝计划—执行—检查—行动，是持续改进的迭代反馈循环。
Plan defines the problem and goals; Do tests a change; Check compares evidence with goals; Act standardizes or revises.
Plan 确定问题与目标；Do 测试改变；Check 将证据与目标比较；Act 标准化或修订。
The slides associate the cycle with Shewhart and Deming. The key learning task is how the cycle works.
课件将该循环与 Shewhart 和 Deming 联系起来；本节核心是理解它如何运作。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师反复强调没有固定“结束点”，改进后仍要持续检视。Improvement is ongoing rather than a one-off event.

辨析与学习提示 / Study note

Lecture 1 的 PDSA 使用 Study；本讲 PDCA 使用 Check。两者都是学习与改进循环，答题应按题目要求写全称。

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 18, 19, 20, 21, 26；Lesson2.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

sections.title: Plan
sections.titleZh: Plan：问题、目标与方案
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Review the current process, identify the problem, define the desired result and plan a manageable change.
检视现有流程、找出问题、明确预期结果，并规划可管理的改变。
A clear goal makes the result easier to monitor. Starting with a small change can make evaluation more manageable.
目标清晰才能监测结果；从小改变开始，更容易评估。
Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 22

sections.title: Do
sections.titleZh: Do：小规模试行并收集数据
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Implement the planned change on a small scale and collect information about its effect.
小规模实施计划中的改变，并收集效果资料。
A pilot is a trial, not immediate full-scale rollout.
Pilot 是试点，不是立即全面推广。
Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 23

sections.title: Check
sections.titleZh: Check：对照目标分析结果
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Analyze data from the trial and compare results with the planned goals or previous performance.
分析试点数据，将结果与预设目标或以往表现比较。
Charts can reveal patterns over repeated cycles and show which changes are promising.
图表可呈现多轮循环的变化规律，帮助判断哪些改变值得保留。
Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 24

sections.title: Act
sections.titleZh: Act：采用、调整或保留原标准
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Use the findings to standardize an effective change, revise the plan, or retain the current standard if improvement is not demonstrated.
根据发现，将有效改变标准化、修订计划，或在未证实改善时保留现有标准。
Unexpected results require further investigation and possibly another cycle.
意外结果需要继续调查，必要时进入新一轮循环。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师明确说：经过 PDCA 后决定保留现有标准，也可以是合理结果。Keeping the current standard can be a valid outcome.

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 25, 26；Lesson2.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

sections.title: PDCA in A&E
sections.titleZh: 急症室等候时间的 PDCA 例子
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Problem: long patient waits in A&E. Plan: design triage and fast-track changes.
问题：急症室等候时间长。Plan：设计分流与快速通道改变。
Do: pilot for one week. Check: review waiting times and satisfaction scores. Act: refine and consider wider implementation based on results.
Do：试行一周。Check：分析等候时间和满意度。Act：依据结果调整，再考虑扩大实施。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

这是课件示例，不是直接可执行的临床分流方案；具体试点需按机构安全与审批要求设计。

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 27

sections.title: PDCA barriers and benefits
sections.titleZh: PDCA 障碍、益处与数据
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Four barriers: resistance to change, inadequate data systems, insufficient training and unclear objectives.
四个障碍：变革阻力、数据系统不足、培训不足、目标不清晰。
Benefits include reducing errors, anticipating disruptions, identifying problems, updating processes, reducing waste and continuous testing.
益处包括减少错误、预防突发问题、识别问题、更新流程、减少浪费、持续测试。
Accurate records can support demand analysis and better resource planning. PDCA does not guarantee that all errors disappear.
准确记录有助于分析需求和规划资源；PDCA 并不保证消除所有错误。
The medication-adherence paper is assigned further reading; its findings are not summarized here.
用药依从性论文属于课件延伸阅读，本节不推断其研究结果。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师强调工作负荷、资源限制及员工是否理解改变的目的；领导需要清晰解释目标并争取合作。Workload and staff understanding affect implementation.

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 28, 29, 30, 31；Lesson2.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

objective.en: Know the five steps and distinguish standardizing from sustaining.
objective.zh: 掌握五步骤，区分标准化与维持。

sections.title: The five S steps
sections.titleZh: 5S 五步骤与顺序
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Sort; Set in Order; Shine; Standardize; Sustain.
整理；整顿；清扫；标准化；维持。
Sort (Seiri): remove unnecessary items. Set in Order (Seiton): arrange what remains for easy access.
Sort：移除不需要的物品。Set in Order：将保留物品安排得易于取用。
Shine (Seiso): clean and maintain. Standardize (Seiketsu): establish procedures. Sustain (Shitsuke): maintain and improve the system.
Shine：清洁维护。Standardize：建立统一程序。Sustain：持续维持并改善系统。
The diagram places the first three steps at the base, followed by standardizing and sustaining.
课件图把前三步放在基础层，再推进标准化和维持。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

中文译名可能不同；复习以英文五个 S 和各自含义为准。

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 32, 33, 34, 35

sections.title: 5S in a pharmacy and operating theatre
sections.titleZh: 药房与手术室的 5S 应用
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Pharmacy: remove expired medicines; label and organize shelves; clean workstations; standardize stocking and dispensing; audit regularly.
药房：移除过期药；标记并整理药架；清洁工作台；统一补货与配药流程；定期审核。
Operating theatre: remove unnecessary items, organize instrument sets, maintain cleanliness, follow standard procedures and keep auditing.
手术室：移除无关物品、安排器械套组、保持清洁、遵循标准程序、持续审核。
Standardize creates a consistent procedure; Sustain keeps it followed over time.
Standardize 是建立一致程序；Sustain 是让程序长期执行。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师提醒：即使采用自动化设备，标准程序、遵循要求和定期审核仍然重要。Automation does not remove the need for procedures and audits.

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 36, 38；Lesson2.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

sections.title: 5S case study and sustainability
sections.titleZh: 5S 案例与持续实施
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
The slide reports a South Texas healthcare centre increasing bed space by 32% without new construction and improving HCAHPS scores.
课件报告一个南德州医疗中心案例：不新建建筑而增加 32% 床位空间，并改善 HCAHPS 评分。
HCAHPS = Hospital Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems; the case links it to patient experience.
HCAHPS 是 Hospital Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems；案例将其用于患者体验评价。
The learning point is to examine how existing space is used before assuming that expansion is necessary.
学习重点：先检查现有空间如何使用，再判断是否需要扩建。
Study application: assign responsibility, train staff and use regular checks to help sustain 5S in a busy setting.
学习应用：明确责任、培训员工、定期检查，有助于在繁忙环境中持续实施 5S。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

数字以 PDF 第37页的 32% 为准；课堂转录中的其他比例有明显噪声，不采用。课件提到27题问卷是该教学材料的表述，未作为当前问卷规格核实。

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 37, 38, 39

objective.en: Understand radical redesign, the four slide principles and digital risks.
objective.zh: 理解根本性重设计、课件四原则及数字化风险。

sections.title: BPR definition and principles
sections.titleZh: BPR 定义与四项原则
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Business Process Re-engineering (BPR) radically redesigns core processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
BPR（业务流程再造）通过根本性重设计核心流程，提高效率与有效性。
1. Organize around outcomes, not tasks. 2. Let those who use the output perform the process.
1. 围绕结果组织流程，而不只围绕单项任务。2. 由流程输出的使用者执行流程。
3. Integrate information processing into the work that produces information. 4. Treat dispersed resources as if centralized.
3. 将信息处理融入产生信息的实际工作。4. 把分散资源视作集中资源来协调。
Study comparison: PDCA often tests incremental changes; BPR focuses on substantial redesign.
学习比较：PDCA 常用于逐步测试改变；BPR 侧重整体性重设计。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

这里列出的是本课件第42页的四项原则，不冒充其他文献中更完整的原则清单。

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 40, 41, 42

sections.title: BPR in patient admission
sections.titleZh: 入院流程再造及风险
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Example: one centralized online system for registration, insurance verification and appointment scheduling.
例子：通过集中式在线系统完成登记、保险核验及预约安排。
Benefits: less paperwork, shorter waits and improved accuracy.
益处：减少文书工作、缩短等候、提高准确性。
Classroom risk discussion: patient privacy and data leakage require maintenance, updates and an ongoing security budget.
课堂风险讨论：患者隐私和数据泄露需要维护、更新及持续安全预算。
Sharing records across departments can support coordination and reduce repeated searches for paper records.
跨部门共享病历有助于协调，减少反复寻找纸质记录。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师接受了“patient privacy / data leakage”的课堂回答，并强调安全更新属于需要持续预算的费用。The lecturer emphasized ongoing maintenance and security spending.

辨析与学习提示 / Study note

结合你的技术背景：可用权限控制、审计和故障回退分析案例；这些是应用延伸，不是课件原列项。

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 43, 44；Lesson2.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

title.zh: 质量功能展开与方法选择

objective.en: Translate patient needs into service specifications and select an appropriate method.
objective.zh: 把患者需求转化为服务规格，并选择适当方法。

sections.title: QFD and the House of Quality
sections.titleZh: QFD 与质量屋
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Quality Function Deployment (QFD) translates spoken and unspoken customer needs into design requirements.
质量功能展开（QFD）把顾客表达及未表达的需求转化为设计要求。
House of Quality: a matrix relating what customers need to how the organization will respond.
质量屋：用矩阵把顾客需要什么与机构如何回应联系起来。
VoC = Voice of the Customer (Whats). VoB = Voice of the Business (Hows).
VoC＝顾客之声（要什么）。VoB＝业务之声（如何做到）。
Other slide components: interrelationship matrix, technical matrix, technical correlations and planning matrix.
课件其他组成：关系矩阵、技术矩阵、技术相关性、规划矩阵。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

课堂转录有 VOP 等识别错误，按 PDF 第47页统一使用 VoB。质量屋不是建筑物，而是关系矩阵。

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 45, 46, 47

sections.title: QFD objectives and steps
sections.titleZh: QFD 三目标与四步骤
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Three objectives: prioritize needs, translate needs into technical characteristics, and deliver a quality product or service that supports customer satisfaction.
三目标：排定需求优先级、把需求转成技术特征、提供让顾客满意的优质产品或服务。
Four steps: identify customer requirements; translate them into technical specifications; relate specifications; develop and prioritize design targets.
四步骤：识别顾客要求；转化为技术规格；分析规格间关系；制定设计目标并排序。
Spoken needs can be stated directly; unspoken needs may require observation and careful questioning.
已表达需求可直接收集；未表达需求可能需要观察和恰当提问。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师强调把抽象需求具体化，例如服务频率或等候时间，才能设计改进。The lecturer emphasized making requirements concrete.

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 48, 49；Lesson2.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

sections.title: QFD rehabilitation example
sections.titleZh: 康复服务：从需求到方案
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Convenient appointment times → extended service hours.
方便的预约时间 → 延长服务时段。
Personalized treatment plans → individualized assessment protocols.
个性化治疗计划 → 个别化评估规程。
Clear communication → patient education materials.
清晰沟通 → 患者教育材料。
Longer service hours require sufficient staffing and funding; the preferred design must be feasible.
延长服务时段需要人手与经费，设计方案必须可行。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师提醒延长服务时间会增加人手与成本，不能只写理想目标。Longer hours have staffing and cost implications.

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 50；Lesson2.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

sections.title: Capturing needs and setting priorities
sections.titleZh: 收集需求与决定优先级
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
Patients may not state all their needs. Use feedback and observation, and prioritize requirements against available resources.
患者可能不会表达全部需求。结合反馈与观察，并按可用资源排列需求优先级。
The slide asks how QFD could support a new patient portal; it emphasizes requirements, technical descriptors and prioritization.
课件提出如何用 QFD 设计患者门户，重点是需求、技术描述与优先级。
Study example: a patient wants fewer missed appointments → design reminders and measure successful delivery and user understanding.
学习例子：患者希望少漏诊预约 → 设计提醒，并检查送达情况及患者是否理解。
Leadership, clear direction and staff cooperation help turn the design into practice.
领导支持、清晰方向和员工合作有助于落实设计。
老师课堂补充 / Classroom commentary

老师指出部分患者不愿表达意见，捕捉“顾客之声”可能有困难。Some patients may be reluctant to express their views.

辨析与学习提示 / Study note

门户提醒例子为新增学习应用，并非课件报告的真实项目或研究结果。

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 51；Lesson2.docx 课堂转录（整理意译）

sections.title: Choose the right method
sections.titleZh: 四种方法怎么选
sections.html:
核心重点 / Key points
PDCA: test and review changes repeatedly. 5S: organize and sustain the workplace.
PDCA：反复测试与检视改变。5S：整理并持续维护工作场所。
BPR: redesign a core process. QFD: translate customer needs into design specifications.
BPR：重设计核心流程。QFD：把顾客需求转成设计规格。
Study synthesis: use QFD to define requirements, BPR to redesign a process, 5S to organize the workplace and PDCA to test improvements. They can complement one another.
学习综合：QFD 明确需求、BPR 重设计流程、5S 整理现场、PDCA 测试改进；不同方法可互相配合。
辨析与学习提示 / Study note

这是跨章节总结与新增练习，不是教师原题。

Lecture 2(1).pdf · PDF pages 17, 26, 34, 41, 49

question.en: List the five reasons why quality management matters in healthcare.
question.zh: 列出医疗质量管理重要性的五点。

answer.en: Patient safety; patient experience; reduced costs and waste; better clinical outcomes; increased efficiency.
answer.zh: 患者安全；患者体验；减少成本与浪费；改善临床结果；提高效率。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 3, 4, 5

question.en: Name the five key principles of quality management.
question.zh: 列出质量管理的五项原则。

answer.en: Customer focus; continuous improvement; data-driven decision making; employee empowerment; systems thinking.
answer.zh: 以服务对象为中心；持续改进；数据驱动决策；员工赋权；系统思维。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 15, 16

question.en: Name the three components of Donabedian’s framework and give one structural example.
question.zh: 列出 Donabedian 框架三部分，并举一个结构例子。

answer.en: Structure, process and outcome. Equipment is a structural example.
answer.zh: 结构、过程、结果。设备属于结构。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 7, 8

question.en: Give two process examples: one involving communication and one involving infection prevention.
question.zh: 举出两个过程例子：一个关于沟通，一个关于感染预防。

answer.en: Doctor-patient communication and infection control measures.
answer.zh: 医患沟通和感染控制措施。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 9

question.en: Name two outcome indicators: one about death and one about returning to hospital.
question.zh: 列出两个结果指标：一个关于死亡，一个关于再次住院。

answer.en: Mortality rate and hospital readmission rate.
answer.zh: 死亡率和再入院率。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 10

question.en: Classify equipment, medication administration and readmission rate in that order.
question.zh: 依次把设备、给药操作、再入院率分为哪三类？

answer.en: Structure; process; outcome.
answer.zh: 结构；过程；结果。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 11, 12

question.en: List all six IOM aims.
question.zh: 列出 IOM 六项目标。

answer.en: Safe; timely; effective; efficient; equitable; patient-centered.
answer.zh: 安全；及时；有效；高效；公平；以患者为中心。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 13, 14

question.en: Which aim concerns scientific evidence, and which concerns avoiding waste?
question.zh: 哪项目标关注科学证据？哪项关注避免浪费？

answer.en: Effective concerns scientific evidence; efficient concerns avoiding waste.
answer.zh: 有效关注科学证据；高效关注避免浪费。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 14, 16

question.en: Expand PDCA in order.
question.zh: 依次写出 PDCA 全称。

answer.en: Plan, Do, Check, Act.
answer.zh: 计划、执行、检查、行动。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 18, 19, 20, 21, 26

question.en: In Plan, what must you define before developing a change?
question.zh: Plan 阶段在设计改变之前，需要明确什么？

answer.en: Define the problem and set goals.
answer.zh: 明确问题并设定目标。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 22

question.en: What two actions belong to Do?
question.zh: Do 阶段做哪两件事？

answer.en: Pilot the change on a small scale and collect data.
answer.zh: 小规模试点并收集数据。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 23

question.en: What happens in Check?
question.zh: Check 阶段做什么？

answer.en: Analyze the data and compare results with goals.
answer.zh: 分析数据，并将结果与目标比较。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 24

question.en: If a trial does not demonstrate improvement, must the new process replace the old standard?
question.zh: 如果试点未显示改善，是否必须用新流程替换原标准？

answer.en: No. Retain the current standard or revise the plan and test again.
answer.zh: 不必须。可保留现有标准，或修订计划后再次测试。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 25, 26

question.en: Which two outcomes are checked in the A&E example?
question.zh: 急症室例子在 Check 阶段检查哪两项？

answer.en: Waiting times and patient satisfaction scores.
answer.zh: 等候时间与患者满意度。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 27

question.en: List the four barriers to PDCA implementation.
question.zh: 列出实施 PDCA 的四个障碍。

answer.en: Resistance to change; inadequate data systems; insufficient training; unclear objectives.
answer.zh: 变革阻力；数据系统不足；培训不足；目标不清晰。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 28, 29, 30, 31

question.en: List the five S steps.
question.zh: 列出 5S 五步骤。

answer.en: Sort; Set in Order; Shine; Standardize; Sustain.
answer.zh: 整理；整顿；清扫；标准化；维持。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 32, 33, 34, 35

question.en: Which S establishes procedures, and which S maintains them through regular audits?
question.zh: 哪个 S 建立程序？哪个 S 通过定期审核维持执行？

answer.en: Standardize establishes procedures; Sustain maintains them.
answer.zh: 标准化建立程序；维持确保持续执行。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 36, 38

question.en: In the slide’s case, how much did bed space increase without new construction?
question.zh: 课件案例在没有新建建筑的情况下增加多少床位空间？

answer.en: 32%. This is a result reported in the teaching case, not a universal 5S effect.
answer.zh: 32%。这是课件案例报告的结果，不是所有 5S 项目的保证效果。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 37, 38, 39

question.en: What does BPR stand for, and what type of redesign does it emphasize?
question.zh: BPR 全称是什么？强调哪种重新设计？

answer.en: Business Process Re-engineering; radical redesign of core processes.
answer.zh: 业务流程再造；核心流程的根本性重新设计。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 40, 41, 42

question.en: Name two data-related risks discussed for the online admission system.
question.zh: 在线入院系统讨论了哪两个数据相关风险？

answer.en: Patient privacy risks and data leakage.
answer.zh: 患者隐私风险与数据泄露。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 43, 44

question.en: In the House of Quality, what do VoC and VoB mean?
question.zh: 质量屋中的 VoC 和 VoB 分别是什么？

answer.en: VoC: Voice of the Customer; VoB: Voice of the Business.
answer.zh: VoC：顾客之声；VoB：业务之声。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 45, 46, 47

question.en: What does QFD translate customer needs into?
question.zh: QFD 把顾客需求转化为什么？

answer.en: Technical characteristics and specifications.
answer.zh: 技术特征与技术规格。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 48, 49

question.en: Which technical response in the rehabilitation example supports clear communication?
question.zh: 康复服务例子用什么具体方案支持清晰沟通？

answer.en: Patient education materials.
answer.zh: 患者教育材料。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 50

question.en: What two categories must managers balance when prioritizing QFD improvements?
question.zh: 为 QFD 改进排序时，管理者需要平衡哪两类因素？

answer.en: Customer requirements and available resources.
answer.zh: 顾客需求与可用资源。

questions.source: 学习辅助题（非教师原题）· Lecture 2 PDF pages 51

question.en: Which method organizes the workplace, and which translates customer needs into specifications?
question.zh: 哪种方法管理工作场所？哪种把顾客需求转成规格？

answer.en: 5S organizes the workplace; QFD translates needs into specifications.
answer.zh: 5S 管理工作场所；QFD 把需求转成规格。
